record.title: NYC Mesh — the people's internet
record.dek: 2,000+ nodes across five boroughs. No corporate gatekeepers. A blueprint for community-owned infrastructure.
record.body: What if your internet wasn't owned by anyone? Not Verizon, not Spectrum, not some Valley-funded 'disruptor' with a Series B and a burn rate. What if your neighborhood just... built it?
